How Apple's New CEO Will Shape the iPhone Maker
videos.description: Apple begins a new era as John Ternus takes over from Tim Cook on September 1st. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman explains why the transition is likely to be gradual, how Ternus could reshape decision-making at Apple, and why his product background matters as the company prepares its next wave of iPhones, Macs and other devices. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech."

videos.title: People Trying Hard To 'Outfox' S&P 500: Cutright
videos.description: Brooks Cutright, portfolio manager at Hedgeye Asset Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." Index tracking funds have nearly $27 trillion tied to the S&P 500. This Friday the S&P 500 is set to announce who may be added or taken out of the index as part of a rebalancing. Thirty-six companies appear to qualify for entry, while more than 110 existing members no longer meet the index's market-cap hurdle. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: T. Rowe Price CEO Sharps on Private Assets and AI Adoption
videos.description: T. Rowe Price CEO Rob Sharps discusses how the company is adapting to the rise of passive investing. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close," Sharps also says private assets are slowly moving into 401(k) plans and sees "tax-loss harvesting" as a growth area. He also discusses how the firm is utilizing artificial intelligence. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
